input.newString:
warning: You are opting in to remove schema identifiers in the bundled schema.
warning: The only legit use case of this advanced feature we know of is to workaround
warning: non-compliant JSON Schema implementations such as Visual Studio Code.
warning: Otherwise, this is not needed and may harm other use cases. For example,
warning: you will be unable to reference the resulting schema from other schemas
warning: using the --resolve/-r option.
